column2: [intro]
I’m a tightrope walker with no balance,
In my madness, I take the chance,
I tread on dreams, agile and free,
Breaking taboos, flirting with excess with glee.
I put my heart on the line,
Trying to dance without a sign,
I’m free, I want this to remain,
Avoiding all obstacles, not feeling the strain.
I carve my path with bold flair,
An artist, a cosmic affair,
Against conventions, I leave my mark,
In my songs, humor’s my spark.
I leap with no trace of sorrow,
Venturing into the unknown, chasing tomorrow,
Living my life with no wisdom to show,
In my limits, I see only the glow.
[ solo ]
I’m a tightrope walker of escape,
Defying laws with passion’s shape,
With me, boredom finds no space,
Follow me boundlessly to our own place.
[outro]
